crossRefs.note: “ ‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,
But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies…
“ ‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not…
I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of…
Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
“One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
“ ‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

translations.web: “ ‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
translations.bsb: If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
translations.kjv: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
translations.asv: But if he smote him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
